analysis_type: source-identity reconciliation and adversarial measurement audit
score_exposure_disclosure: All623 source/database rows were read for identity matching, including coefficients and counts. No positional score-pattern analysis, predictor fitting or performance-based model selection was conducted in this script.

conclusion.supported: All62 literal MaveDB n.<position>= records match original source single-base deletion rows by position, coefficient and all three count columns; p-values match five-decimal rounding.
not_established: The exact import, normalization or migration code path that introduced the equality notation
The date when the representation discrepancy first appeared
That62 source rows represent62 distinct physical alleles after repeat normalization
Global novelty of a legacy MaveDB deletion/equality discrepancy
Independent biological replication, endogenous expression effects or clinical pathogenicity

source_estimate_inconsistency.scope: Original deletion source rows, not SNV evaluation, and not a biological noise floor.
source_estimate_inconsistency.identity: Exact equality of the complete altered187-nt reporter target sequence.
source_estimate_inconsistency.derivation: For each identical input x with observed source coefficients y1..yn, sum_i(yi-f(x))^2 = sum_i(yi-ybar)^2 + n*(f(x)-ybar)^2. Summing nonnegative residual terms gives the finite observed-label lower bound.
source_estimate_inconsistency.interpretation: Different additive-regression coefficients attached to identical isolated edited target sequences are source-estimate inconsistency. Their difference can reflect representation, multi-mutant background assignment, estimation or correlated measurement; it does not demonstrate that identical DNA has different intrinsic biology.
source_estimate_inconsistency.uncertainty: No replicate coefficient covariance or biological error distribution is available here; these algebraic bounds are neither confidence intervals nor estimates of latent experimental noise.

predefined_minimum_ten_tag_qc.interpretation: Apply the study's preexisting minimum10-tag QC before interpreting source-label inconsistency. In this HBB snapshot every raw equivalent pair contains one low-support row, so this duplicate-identity bound vanishes after QC; that does not establish noise-free measurements.

measurement_cautions: The source library used error-prone-PCR multi-mutant constructs. Coefficients are fitted additive effects, not every allele isolated in one clone.
Three transfections share a constructed library; barcode counts are not independent biological replications.
The primary paper explicitly warns that coefficient p-values are inflated by tag-independence assumptions, correlated counts and unmodeled epistasis.

The original raw table retains27 deletion coefficients with fewer than10 tags. The author's visualization filters minimum tag support at display/analysis time; retention is not proof the published downstream filter was violated.
All561 substitution rows have at least10 tags, so the declared substitution-only evaluation is unaffected by the low-tag deletion rows.
Database literal p=0 values are rounded, not true mathematical zeros or infinite evidence.
The62 source deletions yield53 distinct altered187-nt target sequences. Equivalent rows require grouping and provenance-aware resolution before future deletion modeling.
Counts and sequence opportunity may be predictors of estimation noise; held-out sequence positions still share library-wide regression and measurement construction.

clinical_ancestry.scope: the two selected ClinVar SNVs overlapping the reporter fragment
clinical_ancestry.retrieval_state: live XML record versions match the frozen ESummary versions
clinical_ancestry.conclusion: No explicit Kircher2019 citation was found in these XML records. Absence of a citation does not establish independent data, cohorts, organizations, or uncited evidence ancestry.

evaluation_protocol_audit.role: Adversarial interpretation review after protocol freeze, without changing the fixed modeling plan.

checks.assessment: Radius10 sequence supports are disjoint at center distance>20. Grouping alleles by position and guarded contiguous folds addresses direct feature overlap, not source-estimator covariance or biological dependence.

HBB coefficients were jointly fitted from multi-mutant constructs before downstream cross-validation. Disjoint sequence windows do not create independent coefficient-estimation data; unknown covariance remains.

Nine leave-element-out targets are stronger than random variants but still one selected study. Cell-line and construct differences are real transport conditions, not interchangeable independent human promoters.

Minimum10-tag QC is prespecified, not selected to improve performance. All561HBB substitutions meet it. Do not derive significance labels from rounded MaveDB p=0 or interpret low-support raw deletion conflicts as biological noise floors.

Finite equal-input observed-label bounds are algebraic statements about the measured source coefficients. They mix technical variation with possible biology and do not identify either cause or latent error distribution.

Nine-element and position-block resampling conditions on overlapping fitted OOF predictions. Chemistry-stratified rotations break some within-position and library dependence. Retain their declared descriptive/falsification status, not calibrated biological p-values or population confidence intervals.

Forensic matching necessarily read the already exposed HBB coefficients. No new-promoter outcome table was inspected by this analysis, and no model, threshold, motif or split was selected from forensic matches.

prior_public_issue.finding: The issue explicitly warns that a legacy MaveDB F9 source deletion appears as a target-equality expression and recommends source-crosswalk validation.

novelty_check.interpretation: This is a reproduced source-quality finding and HBB-specific reconciliation. A bounded search is not proof of novelty; no globally novel discrepancy is claimed.
